## Budgets

**Sizing.** A visual plan of 2 to 12 images (up to 24 in its largest first copy, about 500 KB each), copied 1 to 4 times, with up to 3 managers finishing plans at once on one shared board token.

**At 10×.** At 10 concurrent first copies, GitHub's secondary rate limiter refuses copies; accepted past 3 at once, which is budgeted.

| Budget | Target | Basis | How it is measured | Check runtime |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [GitHub requests per new image][1] | ≤2 requests | measured | telemetry | ≈1 s |
| [GitHub requests per unchanged image][2] | ≤0 requests | design | telemetry | ≈1 s |
| [Linear requests per new image][3] | ≤3 requests | published docs | telemetry | ≈1 s |
| [Linear requests per unchanged image][4] | ≤0 requests | design | telemetry | ≈1 s |
| [GitHub copy time for a 24-image plan][5] | ≤60 seconds | arithmetic | telemetry | ≈1 s |
| [GitHub copies refused, 3 at once][6] | ≤0 copies | arithmetic | telemetry | ≈1 s |
| [Slowest of 3 concurrent GitHub copies][7] | ≤240 seconds | arithmetic | telemetry | ≈1 s |
| [Linear copy time for a 24-image plan][8] | ≤90 seconds | arithmetic | direct | ≈20 s |
| [Linear copies refused, 3 at once][9] | ≤0 copies | design | not recorded | not recorded |

[1]: https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3304#user-content-github-asset-requests-per-new-asset
[2]: https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3304#user-content-github-asset-requests-per-unchanged-asset
[3]: https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3305#user-content-linear-asset-requests-per-new-asset
[4]: https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3305#user-content-linear-asset-requests-per-unchanged-asset
[5]: https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3304#user-content-github-asset-copy-seconds
[6]: https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3304#user-content-github-concurrent-copies-refused
[7]: https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3304#user-content-github-concurrent-copy-seconds
[8]: https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3305#user-content-linear-asset-copy-seconds
[9]: https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3305

**Not budgeted:**

- how the work scales with data: Requests grow linearly per image and each is budgeted; image size is capped by each destination.
- spend: Accepted exception: the one new dispatch, `spike-visual`, is capped at 40 turns.
- latency (the visual spike delays the design document): Accepted exception: the spike delays the document by at most its 40-turn cap.
- resource use: At most about 12 MB of images per plan, in the gitignored authoring root.
- image retention: Existing authoring storage keeps assets; no retention or deletion policy is added.
- upload bandwidth: Largest copies upload 12 MB on existing transports, without bandwidth control.

**Repo-wide effects:** `ai-orchestrator` / `gate-time`: ai-orchestrator's gate grows a few seconds against its 1800 s gate-time budget.
